The coach as a MOVER. Actor.clip asks for `walk` while moving and `idle` when still, WHATEVER the mover is -- a vehicle is not exempt, so the two clips carry those names. `idle` is the coach standing with its door shut and the case on the rack; `walk` is it leaving with the door shut, which is also what a driver would do.

THE DOOR-OPEN BODY IS NOT REACHABLE FROM A MOVER. A mover has clips, not states, so the coach cannot show its open door while Thad is outside it. The art exists at art/objects/room-01-coach-unloaded.png. Filed.
